title: Metric dynamic labels must use Arc<str>
answers: How should dynamic labels be passed to metrics macros in Rust?
Why are metrics labels required to be Arc<str> instead of String?
What is the convention for metric label allocation in rust/feature-flags?
body:
When emitting metrics with the `metrics` crate (`histogram!`, `counter!`, `gauge!`), dynamic label values (e.g. client names, method names) must be passed as `Arc<str>`, never as `String` or `.to_string()`.
Construct the `Arc<str>` once at the start of the function with `Arc::from(val)` and `.clone()` it into macro calls.
`Arc::clone` is a single atomic increment without heap reallocation on hot paths.
applies: Emitting metrics in Rust crates (`rust/`) with dynamic label values. Does not apply to static string literal labels (&'static str).
says: Feature flag evaluation service suffers high memory allocation spikes under heavy load
High latency and garbage collection pauses when tracking dynamic flag metric labels
Optimize server memory performance during high throughput feature flag checks
Reduce heap allocations caused by dynamic metric labels in flag evaluation workers
